Cortex Code session with in-process tools

code.name: Approver
code.summary: A can_use_tool callback. `ask(title, detail) -> answer` shows a request and reads a line.

code.name: changed_keys
code.signature: def changed_keys(draft: dict, args: dict, ignore: tuple[str, ...]=()) -> list[str]

code.name: describe_permission
code.signature: def describe_permission(tool_name: str, inp: dict[str, Any], prefix: str='') -> tuple[str, str]
code.summary: (title, detail) from Cortex's ("MCP" | "Bash" | ..., {"action", "resource"}). For MCP the first resource line is the tool name; `prefix` (e.g. "mcp__kb__") is stripped from it.

code.name: canon_root
code.signature: def canon_root(env: Mapping[str, str] | None=None) -> Path

code.name: arg_summary
code.signature: def arg_summary(inp: dict[str, Any], width: int=70) -> str

code.name: asks
code.summary: Whether a reply ends by asking something, even with an example after the question mark.

code.name: render
code.signature: def render(console: Console, msg: Any, state: dict, prefix: str='') -> None
code.summary: Text as ⏺ Markdown, tool calls as ⏺ Name(arg), results as ⎿ first line (+N lines), errors red (by flag or an ERROR: prefix), thinking hidden. Updates state: step, asked, model.

code.name: short_name
code.signature: def short_name(name: str, prefix: str='') -> str

code.name: status_label
code.signature: def status_label(state: dict, started: float) -> str
code.summary: '✻ Running scaffold_get… 7s · ctrl-c to interrupt' for console.status().

code.name: create_new
code.signature: def create_new(folder: Path, stem: str, text: str, suffix: str='.md', limit: int=99) -> Path
code.summary: Create folder/stem.md, or stem-2.md, stem-3.md ... never overwriting or following a link.

code.name: inside
code.signature: def inside(dest: Path, rel: str) -> Path
code.summary: The path for `rel` under `dest`. Refuses absolute paths, `..`, any symbolic link on the way (dest/.git -> elsewhere redirects everything beneath it), and anything resolving outside dest.

code.name: write_tree
code.signature: def write_tree(dest: Path, files: dict[str, str]) -> list[Path]
code.summary: Write {relative path: text} under dest, checking every path before writing any.

code.name: Ask
code.signature: Ask = Callable[[str, dict[str, Any], Any], Awaitable[Any]]

code.name: CortexSession
code.summary: Connects on the first turn. Never sets allowed_tools (Cortex treats it as an exclusive allowlist); read-only tools are approved in the permission callback, everything else goes to `ask`, and with no `ask` it is denied.

code.name: TurnStalled
code.summary: Cortex sent nothing for longer than the idle timeout; the turn was interrupted.

code.name: error_result
code.summary: Cortex drops is_error for in-process tools, so the text says ERROR first as well.

code.name: git
code.summary: Run git in repo; raise GitError with its message on failure. Returns stdout.

code.name: hook_script
code.signature: def hook_script(marker: str, command: list[str], fallback: str='') -> str
code.summary: A POSIX hook that runs a kept-aside earlier hook first, then `command`. The command's first word is found on PATH, else at `fallback`; if neither exists it says so instead of skipping silently. Every embedded value is shell-quoted.

code.name: init_own_repo
code.summary: git init repo if needed, then make sure git resolves it to itself and not to a parent repo.

code.name: install_hook
code.signature: def install_hook(repo: Path, name: str, script: str, marker: str) -> str | None
code.summary: Install `script` as hook `name` where git runs hooks. An existing hook that is not ours (no `marker` line) is kept as <name>.local, which our script runs first. Returns why it could not install, or None.

code.name: pointer_problems
code.signature: def pointer_problems(text: str, versions: dict[str, int]) -> list[str]
code.summary: What is wrong with the pointers, given {id: current version}: unknown ids, impossible pins.

code.name: pointers
code.signature: def pointers(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, int | None]]
code.summary: (id, pinned version or None) for every pointer in prose.

code.name: check_out_dir
code.signature: def check_out_dir(out: Path, protect: list[Path], marker: str=MARKER) -> Path
code.summary: The resolved output directory, or ValueError when emptying it could delete something: it is or contains a protected path, home or the root, or it holds files that are not a previous build carrying the marker.

code.name: mark_out_dir
code.signature: def mark_out_dir(out: Path, marker: str=MARKER) -> None

code.name: render_scaffold
code.signature: def render_scaffold(canon_root: Path, entry: dict[str, Any], name: str, purpose: str, test_cmd: str | None=None, lint_cmd: str | None=None) -> dict[str, str]

code.name: scaffold_digest
code.signature: def scaffold_digest(canon_root: Path, entry: dict[str, Any]) -> str
code.summary: SCAFFOLD.md, then each template's path under the scaffold dir and its bytes, as build_index.py hashes.

code.name: check_one_line
code.signature: def check_one_line(label: str, value: str) -> None
code.summary: Raise ValueError unless value is one line of printable text.

code.name: check_project_name
code.signature: def check_project_name(name: str, max_len: int=41) -> str
code.summary: Lowercase words joined by single dashes, whose package name imports. Returns the package name.

code.name: fill_template
code.signature: def fill_template(text: str, values: dict[str, str]) -> str
code.summary: Replace {{key}} in one pass, so a value containing {{other}} stays literal. Unknown keys stay.

code.name: json_literal
code.summary: A string literal valid in JSON, Python, TOML and YAML (double-quoted) at once. Raw Unicode is kept (TOML rejects JSON's surrogate escapes); DEL is escaped (TOML and YAML refuse it raw).

code.name: form
code.signature: async def form(title: str, fields: list[Field], footer: Callable[[dict[str, str]], str], validate: Callable[[dict[str, str]], tuple[str, str] | None]) -> dict[str, str] | None
code.summary: Every field on one screen, already filled with a suggestion. Tab/↓ and Shift-Tab/↑ move, Enter submits from any field. `validate` returns (field key, message) to refuse a submit; `footer` is recomputed on every keystroke.

code.name: pick
code.signature: async def pick(title: str, options: list[tuple[str, str, str]]) -> str | None
code.summary: options: (value, label, description). ↑/↓ or a digit to move, Enter to choose.
